title: dendrobium hesperis
intro: Dendrobium hesperis, commonly known as Hesperis orchid, is a type of epiphytic orchid species native to China and Southeast Asia. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Dendrobium hesperis include its potential anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever and relieving respiratory symptoms. The bioactive constituents of Dendrobium hesperis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
